y%20is%20where%20every%20hyperparameter%20search%20lives.%20If%20it%20is%20fractal%2C%20there%20is%20no%20safe%20margin%20near%20the%20edge%2C%20and%20%22just%20tune%20the%20learning%20rate%20a%20little%22%20sits%20on%20geometry%20with%20structure%20at%20every%20scale.%20**This%20notebook%20rebuilds%20the%20map%20from%20scratch%2C%20lets%20you%20sail%20it%2C%20and%20then%20asks%20the%20question%20the%20paper%20deliberately%20excluded%3A%20does%20the%20coastline%20survive%20the%20noise%20of%20real%20minibatch%20training%3F**%20The%20answer%20is%20measured%2C%20not%20argued.%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20**Rebuilds%20the%20fractal%20from%20scratch.**%20Every%20pixel%20is%20a%20real%20gradient%20descent%20training%20run%2C%20executed%20live%20on%20this%20notebook's%20GPU%20(a%20GPU-less%20fork%20drops%20to%20a%20smaller%20grid%20and%20still%20works).%0A%20%20%20%202.%20**Lets%20you%20sail%20the%20coastline.**%20Pick%20any%20box%20and%20the%20map%20recomputes%20at%20full%20resolution%20inside%20it.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20**Measures%20what%20noise%20does%20to%20it.**%20We%20track%20the%20boundary's%20fractal%20dimension%20as%20minibatch%20noise%20grows%2C%20and%20watch%20the%20coastline%20dissolve.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20(The%20paper's%20alphaXiv%20page%20also%20carries%20an%20AI%20summary%2C%20audio%20overview%2C%20and%20a%20discussion%20tab%20if%20you%20want%20the%20short%20version%20first.)%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20reader_guide(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.callout(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20mo.md(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22**How%20to%20read%20this%20notebook.**%20Every%20figure%20below%20is%20computed%20live%20in%20this%20%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22kernel%3B%20nothing%20is%20prerendered.%20Use%20the%20guided-zoom%20dropdown%20to%20follow%20the%20%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22measured%20route%2C%20drag%20a%20box%20straight%20onto%20the%20map%20to%20sail%20anywhere%20else%2C%20an 20is%20a%20question%20the%20paper's%20own%20artifacts%20leave%20open.%20Treat%20the%20boundary%20as%20an%20ensemble%20object%3A%20give%20every%20pixel%20K%20%3D%2048%20independent%20minibatch%20schedules%20and%20record%20the%20fraction%20that%20converge%2C%20P(converged).%20At%20full%20batch%2C%20P%20is%200%20or%201%20everywhere%20and%20the%20boundary%20is%20the%20crisp%20fractal%20from%20section%201.%20As%20the%20batch%20shrinks%20and%20noise%20grows%2C%20does%20that%20structure%20survive%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20We%20answer%20two%20ways%3A%20by%20eye%2C%20with%20the%20probability%20field%20below%2C%20and%20by%20measurement%2C%20with%20the%20box-counting%20dimension%20of%20the%20P%20%3D%200.5%20contour%20(drawn%20in%20crimson%2C%20like%20every%20boundary%20in%20this%20notebook)%20as%20a%20function%20of%20batch%20size%2C%20bootstrapped%20over%20the%20ensemble.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20batch_slider(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20batch_pick%20%3D%20mo.ui.slider(%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20steps%3D%5B8%2C%2016%2C%2032%2C%2064%2C%20136%2C%20272%5D%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20value%3D64%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20label%3D%22minibatch%20size%20(272%20%3D%20same%20size%20as%20the%20dataset%2C%20drawn%20with%20replacement)%22%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20show_value%3DTrue%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20full_width%3DTrue%2C%0A%20%20%20%20)%0A%20%20%20%20batch_pick%0A%20%20%20%20return%20(batch_pick%2C)%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20sec3_data(np)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20Section%203%20data%2C%20embedded%20so%20the%20notebook%20is%20self-contained%20and%20survives%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20session%20restarts.%20256x256%20grid%2C%2048%20independent%20minibatch%20schedules%20per%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20batch%20size.%20P-fields%20are%20float16%2C%20deterministic%20reference%20is%20a%20bit%20mask%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20zlib%2Bbase64%20(28%20KB).%20The%20heavy%20sweep%20that%20produced%20this%20ran%20once%20on%20the%20GPU.%0A% ler%3A%20an%20earlier%20version%20of%20this%20sweep%2C%20with%20only%2016%20schedules%20per%20point%2C%20appeared%20to%20show%20a%20sharp%20dip%20and%20a%20rebound.%20Quadrupling%20the%20ensemble%20to%2048%20flattened%20both%20into%20the%20plateau%20shown%20here.%20The%20transient%20structure%20was%20sampling%20noise%20in%20the%20estimator%2C%20not%20a%20property%20of%20the%20boundary.%20We%20report%20the%20converged%20result%2C%20and%20the%20estimator%20is%20calibrated%20on%20shapes%20of%20known%20dimension%20in%20the%20appendix.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%20mildest%20noise%20here%20(batch%20272%2C%20the%20size%20of%20the%20dataset%2C%20drawn%20with%20replacement)%20already%20pulls%20the%20dimension%20toward%20the%20plateau%2C%20though%20its%20interval%20is%20wide%20enough%20to%20overlap%20the%20deterministic%20value.%20From%20batch%20136%20down%2C%20the%20erosion%20is%20clearly%20resolved.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20verdict(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Verdict%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Three%20findings%2C%20each%20computed%20live%20in%20this%20notebook%3A%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20**The%20boundary%20is%20fractal.**%20The%20border%20between%20trainable%20and%20divergent%20does%20not%20smooth%20under%20magnification.%20Averaged%20over%20the%20whole%20map%2C%20the%20boundary's%20box-counting%20dimension%20measures%20about%201.19%20at%20section%203's%20resolution%3B%20zoom%20into%20the%20roughest%20stretches%20and%20the%20local%20dimension%20climbs%2C%20reaching%20about%201.9%20in%20the%20guided%20route's%20deepest%20window.%20A%20smooth%20curve%20would%20read%201.0%20at%20every%20scale%2C%20everywhere.%20(Those%20are%20two%20views%20of%20one%20object%3A%20the%20global%20figure%20averages%20long%20tame%20stretches%20of%20coast%20with%20the%20wild%20ones%3B%20the%20zoom%20measures%20the%20wild%20ones%20up%20close.)%0A%20%20%20%202.%20**You%20can%20feel%20why.**%20Park%20the%20replay%20puck%2
